comment: Earlier values the baseline shipped for a seed preference whose value changed (browser/config/prefs/baseline.js). The launcher takes a profile that still has one of them for a profile it seeded and nobody changed, and gives it the baseline's value at its next launch (launcher/nulavio_launcher/profile.py, #384). When a seed preference's value changes, its old value goes into this list; tests/unit/test_profile_and_paths.py fails until the digest below is the baseline's again.
